before.upgrade-el10-gnome-runtime: dnf -y upgrade glib2 fontconfig gobject-introspection gjs

inline.normalize-greetd-keyring-pam: if [ -f /etc/pam.d/greetd ]; then sed --sandbox -i -e '/gnome_keyring.so/ s/-auth/auth/ ; /gnome_keyring.so/ s/-session/session/' /etc/pam.d/greetd; fi
inline.repair-cosmic-greeter-pam: if [ -f /etc/pam.d/cosmic-greeter ] && [ -f /etc/pam.d/greetd ] && [ ! -e /etc/pam.d/common-auth ] && grep -q '^@include common-' /etc/pam.d/cosmic-greeter; then cp /etc/pam.d/greetd /etc/pam.d/cosmic-greeter; fi
